scope: complex-script shaping geometry, bidirectional order and Unicode clusters
implemented: reuses the existing harfrust/cluster pipeline (no second RTF shaper)
pinned OFL Arabic, Tamil and Bengali witnesses (renamed finite subsets)
independent native HarfBuzz geometry oracle for RTL and Indic
logical scalar order covered exactly once per run
one x position per logical scalar
strict SVG delivery of the new witness faces
cluster-safe line-break boundary witness for an unbreakable Devanagari token
PDF Unicode extraction witness for CJK, Devanagari, Arabic, Tamil and Bengali over the shared ActualText path
mixed LTR/RTL run split at import (unicode-bidi; one w:rtl=On segment per RTL run)
remaining: RTF corpus witnesses 007 Sanskrit, 010 Arabic, 011 Tamil, 018 Bengali on their real system faces

blocked.contract: a bidi-aware independent geometry oracle (the native HarfBuzz witness shapes single buffers without the UBA)

native_harfbuzz_geometry.comparison: glyph id, UTF-8 cluster, x/y advance, x/y offset and origin match saved native HarfBuzz TSV

assertions: unicode_cluster_map reconstructs the logical string exactly
every cluster span is non-empty and on char boundaries
unicode_x_positions_px returns one position per scalar
the Arabic logical start is right of the visual left edge
an unbreakable Devanagari token wraps into more than one line piece
no line piece starts with a dependent sign
the pieces concatenate back to the exact logical string

assertions: a run with no w:rtl mixing LTR and RTL becomes direction-homogeneous runs
logical text order is preserved across the split
the RTL segment round-trips as w:rtl On
